Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs both DDA and DIA acquisition modes for the analysis of the ubiquitinome. The primary enrichment strategy is the UbiSite methodology (antibody-based) and Ni-NTA pulldown of His10-Ub. The search parameters explicitly include diGly on lysines as a variable modification.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on two types of enriched material: His10-Ub conjugates purified via Ni-NTA beads and endogenous ubiquitinated peptides purified using the UbiSite antibody approach. Both represent affinity-purified material rather than whole cell lysate.

differential: The calculated difference between treatment and control (DMSO) was used as fold-change vs DMSO.

search_parameters: Cysteine carbamidomethylation was set as fixed modification and N-terminal acetylation, oxidation of methionine and diGly modification on lysine were included as variable modifications.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The study employs three distinct MS strategies: His10-Ub pulldowns (DDA), UbiSite enrichment (DDA), and UbiSite enrichment (DIA). The primary focus is on site-specific ubiquitination (diGly remnant), making site-level differential analysis the priority.
